issues.description: The UML and problem statement specify Animal.name as type String, but the solution implementation declares the name attribute as a StringBuilder. This is a structural type mismatch that could confuse students about the expected attribute type and how to implement getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Animal.name attribute type consistent with the UML and problem statement by using a String field (private String name) and update the getter/setter accordingly. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to explicitly allow StringBuilder if that was intentional.
